exposure: fetal reduction (transabdominal needle-guided injection of potassium chloride)
outcome: adverse pregnancy outcomes (miscarriage before 24 weeks, stillbirth from 24 weeks, or single intrauterine fetal death)
cohort: All Danish dichorionic twin pregnancies (reduced and nonreduced) and a large proportion of randomly selected primary singleton pregnancies with due dates between January 2008 and December 2018 were included.
finding: Transabdominal fetal reduction by needle guide for fetal or maternal indication was safe, with good outcomes for the remaining co-twin, and outcomes were best when the procedure was performed before 14 weeks.
gest_age: Fetal reductions were performed between 11 and 23 weeks, and outcomes included preterm delivery (before 28 weeks, before 32 weeks) and overall gestational age at delivery.
